title: The npm CLI Script
description: bin/mylang.js runs under Node, checks the command-line file, reads it, transpiles it, and prints the output or an error.

steps.description: This is `bin/mylang.js`, the CLI for the npm package. The page says to create the directory `bin/` and add `mylang.js`. The first line is a shebang, which tells the OS to run this file with Node.js. The file imports `fs`, `path`, and the `transpile` function from `../src/index.js`.
It reads the file path from the command line. When no file is given, it prints a usage line to stderr and exits with status 1.
`path.resolve` turns the argument into an absolute path, and `fs.existsSync` checks that the file exists. When it does not, the script prints an error and exits with status 1.
It reads the file as UTF-8 text, calls `transpile`, and prints the output. When `transpile` throws, the catch prints the message and exits with status 1.
